pa_school_house_crag.blurb: School House is a bolted sport cliff in Ohiopyle State Park, set back a short way from the river trail and easy to spot from it. The rock stands roughly 90 feet at its tallest, with most lines closer to 70 feet, and the wall leans out in tiers with a few roofs, so expect steep, powerful climbing. The ten sport routes run from an easy 5.5 up to 5.12, with the bulk of them in the 5.11 range and a handful of gentler leads near the left side for warming up or newer leaders. It is regarded as one of the busiest and most photogenic crags in the park, and a good stop for anyone wanting overhanging sport climbing in the southwestern part of the state.
